result.rationale: Verified in the diff: in addMembers and removeMember the .then callbacks call `self.findMembers();` without `return`, so the promise returned to callers resolves before the member list reload completes and any reload failure is not propagated. The mechanism described is accurate, though practical impact is limited since controller callers (addMembers/removeMember actions) don't chain on the result.
